## Details

### elekloader

Mod loader: user supplies the stock OS file, the tool builds the custom .syx locally. Device table in the README (3016dca, 2026-11-08): Digitakt mk1 and Digitone mk1/Keys supported; Digitakt II 1.17 and Digitone II 1.12 experimental; Octatrack 1.40C supported (linkable core boots on an MKII); Model:Cycles and Model:Samples 1.13 supported (builds work on both units); Analog Rytm MKII 1.74 supported; Analog Four MKII 1.56 experimental proof of concept (hook bus, mod storage, unused DDR and recovery checked on a unit). Canonical repo is unclear: the forum post also embeds github.com/elekloader/elekloader (web app at elekloader.github.io/elekloader); forks exist (AvroraPolnareff, naturarum, toonst, simonjohansson); none is listed, as none has changes of its own. Forum: builder issue reported 2026-10-19. Licence GPL-2.0-or-later. 2026-11-10 (8daa2ea): the shop's list, forms and bots moved to elekloader/shop (#338); mods are submitted there. machine-pages 1.8-1.10, machines-dn1 0.5/0.6 and machines-dn2 0.5 add mono machines and MIDI CCs (emulator-tested per TESTS.md). The linker now refuses odd jump targets into mod RAM after a Digitakt II froze at boot (I61). The README offers a Windows .exe; not every release carries the macOS .dmg. 2026-11-10 (main): core-ar2 0.13 opens the Rytm MKII's TEST slots 44-52 to mod machines, adds per-voice trig and velocity getters, screen calls through stock's routines and per-mod knob ids; machine-pages 1.7 tagged. 2026-11-12 (main): core-a4mk2 0.6 brings core-ar2 0.10-0.13's foundations to the Analog Four MKII (field defaults, the modified mark, the project-save event, payloads, knob looks, screen calls) and a 37.7 MB mods' area. Builds pick older core or helper versions by themselves when a mod patches a place a newer one took (Tone+FX's Digitakt files and Digi EQ 1.0c link with DT1 core 4.0 only; OB-1 0.6 with machine-pages 1.2), and released versions stay available while a listed mod needs them.

_Latest seen (2026-10-31, secondary directories): altstrument.org and the repo (read 2026-10-31): canonical repo is github.com/elekloader/elekloader (183 commits, 103 stars, GPL-2.0-or-later); web app moved to elekloader.github.io/elekloader; the Mac app was absent from v0.9.0 because signing secrets need renewing. v0.9.0 cores: core-4.1 and core-4.1-os1.54 (Digitakt mk1), core-dn1-4.1.1 and -os1.44 (Digitone mk1), core-ar2-0.8 (Analog Rytm MKII 1.74), core-ot-0.8 (Octatrack 1.40C), core-mc-0.3 (Model:Cycles), core-ms-0.1 (Model:Samples), core-a4 0.1-0.4 (Analog Four MKII 1.56). Kit 0.7.0 catalog: 19 cores, 88 mods. machine-pages 1.2/1.3/1.5 need core 3.0+ on Digitakt mk1 and refuse NEIGHBOR 0.6, SOPHIE 1.1.13 and digichain-based machine mods beside them; fxkit 0.1 gives Digitone effect mods a shared mixer, two LFOs, pattern p-locks and a CPU guard; core-dn1 4.1 adds ev_note_queue; kit 0.6.0 gives 4.0 cores larger RAM areas (256 KB Digitakt, 1.25 MB Digitone). docs/ includes AGENTS.md, DEVICES.md, MACHINES-DN2, SHARC-DN2, CORES, FORMAT, BUILDING, ADAPTING (not all read yet - see hardware/MINING.md). The earlier irpina/elekloader repo is where the author's older releases lived._

_Related: uses tool `digikit` (README: checks or gates run in digikit's emulator (not shipped)) - see [PROJECT-FAMILIES.md](PROJECT-FAMILIES.md)_

_Sources: forum thread 30, GitHub release v0.4.0, gearnews, dubspot_

### 1-Bit Editor

Repo offline since 2026-11-07, taken offline by its author together with the other public repos of the same account (check_updates 2026-11-08). Browser pixel editor for 1-bit icons and sprites in the column-wise layout the Model OS uses. Licence: MIT; distribution: browser-installer. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_

### Modded Cycles

One community OS for Model:Cycles 1.13, built in a browser from your own files (needs a Syntakt 1.41/1.42 file for its engines): sampler, Syntakt engines, Braids and Open303 machines, extra LFOs, arp, 6-ch USB audio. Experimental on Model:Samples. Licence: MIT; distribution: browser-installer. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Related: cites `elektron-firmware-tool` (README credits); cites `elektroid` (README credits: the Elektron Transfer update protocol behind fast USB flashing); bundles `model-tg` (README: Model-TG's Sampler as the 7th machine); bundles `elektron-model-tweaks` (README: includes drumkilla's tweaks (latching mute, trig preview)); bundles `ms-multi-output` (README: 6-channel audio after scottmetoyer/ms-multi-output); cites `octamax` (README credits: reverse-engineering method); cites `octa-bt-pt` (README credits: reverse-engineering and patching) - see [PROJECT-FAMILIES.md](PROJECT-FAMILIES.md)_

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01), README (2026-11-11)_

Web flasher and CLI tweaks for Model:Samples and Model:Cycles 1.13 (16-ch USB audio, latching mute, trig preview, stereo samples on M:S). Licence: MIT; distribution: browser-installer. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

### model909

Replaces the six stock machines with circuit-modelled TR-909 voices (integer models fitted to recordings); the experimental branch adds 808 and 606 voices on SHAPE. Hats/cymbals need user-supplied WAVs. MIT.

_Related: builds on `modded-cycles` (README: built on Modded-Cycles and Model-TG); builds on `model-tg` (README: Model-TG is ticked with model909) - see [PROJECT-FAMILIES.md](PROJECT-FAMILIES.md)_

_Sources: GitHub search 2026-11-02, README, README (2026-11-11)_

### ElekPrep (elektron-sample-prep)

Single-page browser sample prep: trims at zero crossings, converts to 48 kHz 16-bit WAV, works out loop lengths from BPM and steps; profiles for four devices (device list taken from the related ElekPrep Transfer app, not checked). No MIDI; files go to the unit through Transfer or Elektroid. MIT.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-03), README_

### ElekPrep Transfer

Closed-source browser app that preps audio and sends it over Web MIDI SysEx to the +Drive, with Transfer and +Drive Manager views and device profiles for Digitakt II, Digitakt, Analog Rytm (MKI/MKII) and Model:Samples. Proprietary; author not named. Relation to luizvarela's ElekPrep not established (same name). Interesting as a second independent implementation of +Drive upload over SysEx.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-03)_

### Model:Samples battery base

Open-hardware battery base using the original side mounting points and the left battery input: editable CAD, STEP/STL, parts list, build guide and printable fit gauges. No working physical prototype validated yet. Found by GitHub search 2026-11-07.

_Sources: GitHub search 2026-11-07, README, README (2026-11-11)_
